name: 乾为天
xiang:
The movement of heaven is full of power.
Thus the superior man makes himself strong and
untiring.

name: 坤为地
xiang:
The earth's condition is receptive devotion.
Thus the superior man who has breadth of character
Carries the outer world.

name: 水雷屯
xiang:
Clouds and thunder:

The image of DIFFICULTY AT THE BEGINNING.

Thus the superior man
Brings order out of confusion.

name: 山水蒙
xiang:
A spring wells up at the foot of the mountain:
The image of YOUTH.

Thus the superior man fosters his character
By thoroughness in all that he does.

name: 水天需
xiang:
Clouds rise up to heaven:
The image of WAITING.
Thus the superior man eats and drinks,
Is joyous and of good cheer.

name: 天水讼
xiang:
Heaven and water go their opposite ways:
The image of CONFLICT.
Thus in all his transactions the superior man
Carefully considers the beginning.

name: 地水师
xiang:
In the middle of the earth is water:
The image of THE ARMY.

Thus the superior man increases his masses
By generosity toward the people.

name: 水地比
xiang:
On the earth is water:
The image of HOLDING TOGETHER.

Thus the kings of antiquity
Bestowed the different states as fiefs
And cultivated friendly relations
With the feudal lords.

name: 风天小畜
xiang:
The wind drives across heaven:
The image of THE TAMING POWER OF THE SMALL.Thus the superior man
Refines the outward aspect of his nature.

name: 天泽履
xiang:
Heaven above, the lake below:
The image of TREADING.

Thus the superior man discriminates between high and low,
And thereby fortifies the thinking of the people.

name: 地天泰
xiang:
Heaven and earth unite: the image of PEACE.
Thus the ruler
Divides and completes the course of heaven and earth,
And so aids the people.

name: 天地否
xiang:
Heaven and earth do not unite:
The image of STANDSTILL.
Thus the superior man falls back upon his inner worth
In order to escape the difficulties.
He does not permit himself to be honored with revenue.

name: 天火同人
xiang:
Heaven together with fire:

The image of FELLOWSHIP WITH MEN.
Thus the superior man organizes the clans
And makes distinctions between things.

name: 火天大有
xiang:
Fire in heaven above:

The image of POSSESSION IN GREAT MEASURE.
Thus the superior man curbs evil and furthers good,
And thereby obeys the benevolent will of heaven.

name: 地山谦
xiang:
Within the earth, a mountain:

The image of MODESTY.

Thus the superior man reduces that which is too much,
And augments that which is too little.
He weighs things and makes them equal.

name: 雷地豫
xiang:
Thunder comes resounding out of the earth:
The image of ENTHUSIASM.
Thus the ancient kings made music
In order to honor merit,
And offered it with splendor
To the Supreme Deity,
Inviting their ancestors to be present.

name: 泽雷随
xiang:
Thunder in the middle of the lake:
The image of FOLLOWING.
Thus the superior man at nightfall
Goes indoors for rest and recuperation.

name: 山风蛊
xiang:
The wind blows low on the mountain:
The image of DECAY.
Thus the superior man stirs up the people
And strengthens their spirit.

name: 地泽临
xiang:
The earth above the lake:
The image of APPROACH.
Thus the superior man is inexhaustible
In his will to teach,
And without limits
In his tolerance and protection of the people.

name: 风地观
xiang:
The wind blows over the earth:
The image of CONTEMPLATION.
Thus the kings of old visited the regions of the world,
Contemplated the people,
And gave them instruction.

name: 火雷噬嗑
xiang:
Thunder and lighting:
The image of BITING THROUGH.
Thus the kings of former times made firm the laws
Through clearly defined penalties.

name: 山火贲
xiang:
Fire at the foot of the mountain:

The image of GRACE.
Thus does the superior man proceed
When clearing up current affairs.
But he dare not decide controversial issues in this way.

name: 山地剥
xiang:
The mountain rests on the earth:
The image of SPLITTING APART.
Thus those above can ensure their position
Only by giving generously to those below.

name: 地雷复
xiang:
Thunder within the earth:
The image of THE TURNING POINT.
Thus the kings of antiquity closed the passes
At the time of solstice.
Merchants and strangers did not go about,
And the ruler
Did not travel through the provinces.

name: 天雷无妄
xiang:
Under heaven thunder rolls:
All things attain the natural state of innocence.

Thus the kings of old,
Rich in virtue, and in harmony with the time,
Fostered and nourished all beings.

name: 山天大畜
xiang:
Heaven within the mountain:

The image of THE TAMING POWER OF THE GREAT.

Thus the superior man acquaints himself with many sayings of antiquity
And many deeds of the past,
In order to strengthen his character thereby.

name: 山雷颐
xiang:
At the foot of the mountain, thunder:

The image of PROVIDING NOURISHMENT.

Thus the superior man is careful of his words
And temperate in eating and drinking.

name: 泽风大过
xiang:
The lake rises above the trees:

The image of PREPONDERANCE OF THE GREAT.

Thus the superior man, when he stands alone,
Is unconcerned,
And if he has to renounce the world,
He is undaunted.

name: 坎为水
xiang:
Water flows on uninterruptedly and reaches its foal:

The image of the Abysmal repeated.

Thus the superior man walks in lasting virtue
And carries on the business of teaching.

name: 离为火
xiang:
That which is bright rises twice:

The image of FIRE.

Thus the great man, by perpetuating this brightness,
Illumines the four quarters of the world.

name: 泽山咸
xiang:
A lake on the mountain:

The image of influence.

Thus the superior man encourages people to approach him
By his readiness to receive them.

name: 雷风恒
xiang:
Thunder and wind: the image of DURATION.

Thus the superior man stands firm
And does not change has direction.

name: 天山遯
xiang:
Mountain under heaven: the image of RETREAT.

Thus the superior man keeps the inferior man at a distance,

Not angrily but with reserve.

name: 雷天大壮
xiang:
Thunder in heaven above:

The image of THE POWER OF THE GREAT.

Thus the superior man does not tread upon paths

That do not accord with established order.

name: 火地晋
xiang:
The sun rises over the earth:

The image of PROGRESS.

Thus the superior man himself
Brightens his bright virtue.

name: 地火明夷
xiang:
The light has sunk into the earth:

The image of DARKENING OF THE LIGHT.

Thus does the superior man live with the great mass:
He veils his light, yet still shines.

name: 风火家人
xiang:
Wind comes forth from fire:

The image of THE FAMILY.Thus the superior man has substance in his words
And duration in his way of life.

name: 火泽睽
xiang:
Above, fire; below. The lake.

The image of OPPOSITION.

Thus amid all fellowship

The superior man retains his individuality.

name: 水山蹇
xiang:
Water on the mountain:

The image of OBSTRUCTION.

Thus the superior man turns his attention to himself
And molds his character.

name: 雷水解
xiang:
Thunder and rain set in:

The image of DELIVERANCE.

Thus the superior man pardons mistakes
And forgives misdeeds.

name: 山泽损
xiang:
At the foot of the mountain, the lake:

The image of DECREASE.

Thus the superior man controls his anger
And restrains his instincts.

name: 风雷益
xiang:
Wind and thunder: the image of INCREASE.

Thus the superior man:
If he sees good, he imitates it;
If he has faults, he rids himself of them.

name: 泽天夬
xiang:
The lake has risen up to heaven:

The image of BREAK-THROUGH.

Thus the superior man
Dispenses riches downward
And refrains from resting on his virtue.

name: 天风姤
xiang:
Under heaven, wind:

The image of COMING TO MEET.

Thus does the prince act when disseminating his commands
And proclaiming them to the four quarters of heaven.

name: 泽地萃
xiang:
Over the earth, the lake:

The image of GATHERING TOGETHER.

Thus the superior man renews his weapons
In order to meet the unforeseen.

name: 地风升
xiang:
Within the earth, wood grows:

The image of PUSHING UPWARD.

Thus the superior man of devoted character
Heaps up small things
In order to achieve something high and great.

name: 泽水困
xiang:
There is not water in the lake:

The image of EXHAUSTION.

Thus the superior man stakes his life
On following his will.

name: 水风井
xiang:
Water over wood: the image of THE WELL.

Thus the superior man encourages the people at their work,
And exhorts them to help one another.

name: 泽火革
xiang:
Fire in the lake: the image of REVOLUTION.

Thus the superior man

Sets the calendar in order
And makes the seasons clear.

name: 火风鼎
xiang:
Fire over wood:

The image of THE CALDRON.

Thus the superior man consolidates his fate
By making his position correct.

name: 震为雷
xiang:
Thunder repeated: the image of SHOCK.

Thus in fear and trembling

The superior man sets his life in order
And examines himself.

name: 艮为山
xiang:
Mountains standing close together:

The image of KEEPING STILL.

Thus the superior man
Does not permit his thoughts

To go beyond his situation.

name: 风山渐
xiang:
On the mountain, a tree:

The image of DEVELOPMENT.

Thus the superior man abides in dignity and virtue,
In order to improve the mores.

name: 雷泽归妹
xiang:
Thunder over the lake:

The image of THE MARRYING MAIDEN.

Thus the superior man
Understands the transitory
In the light of the eternity of the end.

name: 雷火丰
xiang:
Both thunder and lightning come:

The image of ABUNDANCE.

Thus the superior man decides lawsuits
And carries out punishments.

This hexagram has a certain connection with Shih Ho, BITING THROUGH

name: 火山旅
xiang:
Fire on the mountain:

The image of THE WANDERER.

Thus the superior man
Is clear-minded and cautious
In imposing penalties,
And protracts no lawsuits.

name: 巽为风
xiang:
Winds following one upon the other:

The image of THE GENTLY PENETRATING.

Thus the superior man

Spreads his commands abroad
And carries out his undertakings.

name: 兑为泽
xiang:
Lakes resting one on the other:

The image of THE JOYOUS.

Thus the superior man joins with his friends
For discussion and practice.

name: 风水涣
xiang:
The wind drives over the water:

The image of DISPERSION.

Thus the kings of old sacrificed to the Lord
And built temples.

name: 水泽节
xiang:
Water over lake: the image of LIMITATION.

Thus the superior man
Creates number and measure,
And examines the nature of virtue and correct conduct.

name: 风泽中孚
xiang:
Wind over lake: the image of INNER TRUTH.

Thus the superior man discusses criminal cases
In order to delay executions.

name: 雷山小过
xiang:
Thunder on the mountain:

The image of PREPONDERANCE OF THE SMALL.

Thus in his conduct the superior man gives preponderance to reverence.
In bereavement he gives preponderance to grief.
In his expenditures he gives preponderance to thrift.

name: 水火既济
xiang:
Water over fire: the image of the condition
In AFTER COMPLETION.

Thus the superior man

Takes thought of misfortune
And arms himself against it in advance.

name: 火水未济
xiang:
Fire over water:

The image of the condition before transition.

Thus the superior man is careful
In the differentiation of things,

So that each finds its place.
